$comment: Exact Figma layer values per variant (Sort UI 2.0, Light), exported with .claude/skills/figma-to-component/scripts/export-spec.js. layers is a pool of unique specs; variants maps nodeId -> layer path -> pool index. Radius overridden on purpose: every control is 8 px and items inside the menu's 4 px padding are 4 px (Figma draws 10 px fields, a 14 px menu and 10 px items); see the README's design findings.
